result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the cap is mutual and equals the greater of twelve months’ paid or payable Fees and USD 1,000,000; Excluded Claims are expressly uncapped; the consequential-damages exclusion is mutual; and Excluded Claims include confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and IP infringement or misappropriation. Section 21.3 also appropriately treats undisputed Fees for conforming Services as payment obligations rather than capped damages. The revision is limited to the deficient cap language in Section 21.1, resolves the prior conflict created by “without exception,” preserves the remaining risk allocation, and is professionally drafted.
